title: NetSuite ERP — Master Module Catalog
description: Reference taxonomy of NetSuite ERP modules/features used to drive a Current State Assessment. Client-agnostic. Each module carries: where it is detected (Enable Features tab / installed bundle / setup page), how to tell ACTIVE from DORMANT (a usage probe, usually a saved-search transaction count), and its relevance to NSPB (NetSuite Planning & Budgeting). The assessment merges this catalog with per-client extracted data and classifies each module as active / partial / dormant / absent.

stateModel.active: Feature is enabled AND has real usage in the telemetry window (transactions, records, script executions).
stateModel.partial: Enabled and configured but usage is low / only a subset of the capability is used (e.g. ARM enabled but only on one item class).
stateModel.dormant: Enabled (or licensed) but ~zero usage in the window. Candidate to turn off / clean up / re-train. Cost without value.
stateModel.absent: Not enabled / not installed. If it would help this client it is an UPSELL candidate; flagged in the 'what you could use' section.

detectionSources.enable_features: Setup > Company > Enable Features. The master inventory of toggled-on modules. Each subtab = an 'area'. A checked box => enabled.
detectionSources.installed_bundles: Customization > SuiteBundler > Search & Install Bundles > List. SuiteApps installed (FAM, ARM connector, NSPB connector, etc.).
detectionSources.saved_search: A transaction/record saved search grouped by type over the telemetry window — the ground truth for active vs dormant.
detectionSources.setup_page: A specific setup list page (Subsidiaries, Accounting Books, Accounting Periods, Custom Segments, Scripts, Workflows, Integrations).
detectionSources.suiteql: Optional, if an integration token exists: query against transaction / customrecord / system tables for volumes.

nspbRelevanceLegend.feeds-actuals: This module produces GL/transactional data that NSPB pulls in as Actuals (via the NetSuite↔Planning data integration / saved searches).
nspbRelevanceLegend.feeds-dimension: This module's structure maps to an NSPB dimension (subsidiary→Entity, account→Account, class/dept/location/custom-segment→custom dims).
nspbRelevanceLegend.driver: Operational/statistical data that can drive NSPB calculations (headcount, units, statistical accounts).
nspbRelevanceLegend.replaced-by-nspb: NetSuite-native capability that NSPB typically supersedes (native Budgets, basic forecasting). Relevant because keeping both = duplicate source of truth.
nspbRelevanceLegend.governance: Affects how/whether the integration can run (multi-book, accounting contexts, currencies, periods alignment).
nspbRelevanceLegend.none: No direct NSPB relevance; part of ERP-health picture only.

modules.name: OneWorld / Subsidiaries

detect.signal: checkbox; then Setup > Company > Subsidiaries list

modules.usageProbe: Count of active subsidiaries; transactions posted per subsidiary in window.

nspb.note: Subsidiary hierarchy maps directly to the NSPB Entity dimension. Number/structure of subs drives Planning entity rollups and intercompany.

modules.upsell: If single-entity but client is acquiring/expanding, OneWorld is the prerequisite for multi-entity planning.

modules.name: Multiple Currencies
modules.usageProbe: Distinct transaction currencies in window; currency revaluation runs.

nspb.note: Determines whether NSPB needs multi-currency cubes / currency conversion. Currencies + rates feed Planning FX.

modules.name: Multi-Book Accounting (Accounting Books)

detect.signal: checkbox; Setup > Accounting > Manage Accounting Books

modules.usageProbe: Number of accounting books; postings per secondary book.

nspb.note: Critical: NSPB integration pulls from a specific book. Multi-book means deciding WHICH book is the Planning actuals source (primary vs adjustment/IFRS book).

modules.name: Accounting Periods & Fiscal Calendar

detect.where: Setup > Accounting > Manage Accounting Periods; Setup > Company > Fiscal Calendars
detect.signal: period list, fiscal year start month

modules.usageProbe: Period close status (are periods being locked/closed on schedule?).

nspb.note: Fiscal calendar / period structure must align with NSPB Period & Year dims. Mismatched calendars break the actuals load.

modules.name: Chart of Accounts / Account Numbers

detect.where: Lists > Accounting > Accounts; Enable Features > Accounting > Account Numbers
detect.signal: account count, numbering scheme, account types in use

modules.usageProbe: Active accounts with postings in window vs total accounts.

nspb.note: GL accounts are the backbone of the NSPB Account dimension. COA size/shape determines Planning Account hierarchy and how the actuals map.

modules.name: Classifications: Class / Department / Location
modules.usageProbe: Share of transactions tagged with each classification (untagged % = data quality risk for Planning).

nspb.note: Class/Dept/Location are the natural source for NSPB custom dimensions. Tagging discipline directly determines whether Planning can slice by them.

modules.upsell: Low tagging rates are a finding: Planning can only be as granular as the actuals are tagged.

modules.name: Custom Segments (SuiteGL)

detect.where: Customization > Lists, Records & Fields > Custom Segments
detect.signal: custom segment records, which record types they apply to

modules.usageProbe: Transactions using each custom segment in window.

nspb.note: Custom segments are the ERP-side analog of extra Planning dimensions (e.g. Product, Project, Channel). Direct candidates to mirror as NSPB custom dims.

modules.upsell: If the business plans by a dimension that isn't a NetSuite segment, recommend a custom segment so actuals can be tagged at source.

modules.name: Statistical Accounts

detect.signal: checkbox; statistical account type in COA

modules.usageProbe: Statistical journal volume in window.

nspb.note: Headcount, sq ft, units — the operational drivers Planning needs for driver-based models. If absent, Planning drivers must come from elsewhere.

modules.upsell: If client wants driver-based planning (rev per head, cost per unit), statistical accounts are the clean way to feed actual drivers.

modules.name: NetSuite Native Budgets

detect.signal: checkbox; Transactions > Financial > Set Up Budgets

modules.usageProbe: Budget records created/updated in window.

nspb.note: Native budgets are exactly what NSPB supersedes. If still in use alongside NSPB = duplicate source of truth; finding + migration story.

modules.name: Amortization (Expense)
modules.usageProbe: Active amortization schedules; amortization JE volume.

nspb.note: Amortized expense (prepaids) flows into actuals; Planning may need to model future amortization. Schedules are predictable → good for Planning.

modules.name: Advanced Revenue Management (ARM)

detect.where: Enable Features > Accounting > Revenue Recognition / ARM; bundle list

modules.usageProbe: Revenue arrangements / rev rec plans active; deferred revenue balances.

nspb.note: Recognized + deferred revenue are core actuals for revenue planning. ARM presence shapes how revenue is forecast (point-in-time vs over time).

modules.upsell: If revenue is recognized manually via JEs, ARM is an upsell that also makes revenue actuals cleaner for Planning.

modules.name: Fixed Assets Management (FAM)
modules.usageProbe: Active asset records; depreciation runs in window.

nspb.note: Depreciation actuals + asset roll-forward feed capex/depreciation planning. FAM schedules are predictable inputs for Planning.

modules.upsell: If depreciation is tracked in spreadsheets, FAM is an upsell and feeds Planning capex models directly.

modules.name: Expense / Dynamic Allocations

detect.where: Accounting tab > Expense Allocation / Dynamic Allocation

modules.usageProbe: Allocation schedule runs in window.

nspb.note: Allocated actuals (shared cost spread to depts) must match how Planning allocates — otherwise plan vs actual won't reconcile at the dept level.

modules.name: Intercompany Framework / Automated Intercompany

detect.where: Company tab > Intercompany Framework / Automated Intercompany Management

modules.usageProbe: Intercompany transactions/eliminations in window.

nspb.note: Intercompany eliminations affect consolidated actuals. Planning consolidation must mirror the ERP elimination logic.

modules.name: Accounts Receivable / Invoicing

detect.where: Transaction search by type: Invoice, Credit Memo, Cash Sale, Customer Payment

modules.usageProbe: Invoice/payment volume in window.

nspb.note: Revenue + AR actuals. Billing cadence informs revenue/cash planning.

modules.name: Accounts Payable / Vendor Bills

detect.where: Transaction search by type: Vendor Bill, Bill Payment, Vendor Credit, Purchase Order

modules.usageProbe: Bill/PO/payment volume in window.

nspb.note: Expense + AP actuals; PO/commitment data can feed expense planning and cash forecasting.

modules.name: SuiteBilling (Subscription Billing)
modules.usageProbe: Active subscriptions; charges generated in window.

nspb.note: Recurring revenue + MRR/ARR actuals — ideal feed for subscription revenue planning and renewals modeling.

modules.upsell: If recurring revenue is invoiced manually, SuiteBilling cleans up the actuals and unlocks renewals/churn planning.

modules.name: Inventory & Multi-Location Inventory

detect.where: Items & Inventory tab > Inventory, Multi-Location Inventory, Lot/Serial, Bin
detect.signal: checkboxes; item records, item fulfillment volume

modules.usageProbe: Inventory item count; item receipts/fulfillments in window.

nspb.note: COGS + inventory balances are actuals for margin and balance-sheet planning. Inventory valuation feeds working-capital forecasts.

modules.name: Demand Planning
modules.usageProbe: Demand plans generated in window.

nspb.note: Unit forecasts can drive revenue/COGS in Planning. Overlaps with NSPB — decide where the unit forecast lives.

modules.name: Manufacturing (Work Orders, WIP, Routings)

detect.where: Items & Inventory tab > Assemblies / Work Orders / Manufacturing

modules.usageProbe: Work orders / assembly builds in window.

nspb.note: Production cost actuals (labor, overhead, materials) feed cost planning. Routings/BOM drive standard-cost models.

modules.name: Project Management / SuiteProjects

detect.where: Company tab > Projects; CRM/Projects features (Charge-Based Billing, Project Profitability)

modules.usageProbe: Active projects; project transactions/time in window.

nspb.note: Projects can map to an NSPB dimension; project P&L actuals feed project/portfolio planning. (Relevant to Enfinity-style project planning.)

modules.upsell: If they plan by project but don't track project actuals in NetSuite, that's the gap that makes project planning unreconcilable.

modules.name: SuitePeople HR

detect.signal: checkbox; employee records with HR data

modules.usageProbe: Employee records maintained; HR transactions.

nspb.note: Headcount + compensation actuals are the gold source for NSPB Workforce planning. Employee master feeds position/headcount models.

modules.upsell: If headcount lives in spreadsheets, SuitePeople (or at least employee records) makes Workforce planning actuals-driven.

modules.name: Payroll
modules.usageProbe: Payroll runs in window.

nspb.note: Actual payroll cost is the comparison baseline for Workforce/compensation planning.

modules.name: Expense Reports / Time Tracking

detect.where: Employees tab > Expense Reports, Time Tracking

modules.usageProbe: Expense reports / time entries in window.

nspb.note: T&E actuals + billable time feed expense planning and (for services) utilization/revenue models.

modules.name: NetSuite Account Reconciliation (EPM)

detect.where: Bundle / EPM connector for Account Reconciliation

modules.usageProbe: Reconciliations managed in window.

nspb.note: Same EPM family as NSPB. Reconciled balances increase trust in the actuals NSPB consumes. Natural cross-sell with Planning.

modules.upsell: If month-end recs are in spreadsheets, ARCS is a direct EPM cross-sell alongside NSPB.

modules.name: NetSuite Planning & Budgeting Data Integration

detect.where: Bundle / saved searches feeding Planning; Setup > Integration
detect.signal: NSPB connector bundle, saved searches named for Planning loads, integration records

modules.usageProbe: Integration job runs / saved-search exports to Planning in window.

nspb.note: THE bridge. This is how actuals get from NetSuite into NSPB. Its presence/health is the single most important integration finding.

modules.upsell: If NSPB exists but pulls actuals via manual export, the native connector / scheduled saved searches are the fix.

modules.name: SuiteAnalytics Connect (ODBC/JDBC)

detect.signal: checkbox; Connect driver / external BI connections

modules.usageProbe: Connect query usage (web services log).

nspb.note: Alternate pipe to extract actuals for Planning/BI at scale. Relevant if the standard connector can't carry the needed granularity.

modules.name: SuiteAnalytics Workbook
modules.usageProbe: Workbooks created/used.

nspb.note: ERP reporting maturity signal. Heavy workbook use can indicate reporting needs that Planning/EPM could centralize.

modules.name: SuiteScript (Client + Server)

detect.signal: deployed scripts by type, status active/inactive

modules.usageProbe: Active script deployments; execution log volume in window.

nspb.note: Customization footprint. Scripts that touch GL/transactions can affect the integrity/timing of actuals NSPB pulls.

modules.name: SuiteFlow (Workflows)

detect.signal: active workflows, what records they run on

modules.usageProbe: Active workflows; workflow instances in window.

nspb.note: Approval/automation maturity. Workflow-driven close steps affect when actuals are final and loadable to Planning.

modules.name: Custom Records (SuiteBuilder)

detect.where: Customization > Lists, Records & Fields > Record Types

modules.usageProbe: Custom record instances in window.

nspb.note: ERP extension footprint; occasionally a custom record holds data Planning would want (rare).

modules.name: Integrations: SOAP/REST Web Services, TBA, OAuth2

detect.where: Setup > Integration > Manage Integrations; Web Services Usage Log
detect.signal: integration records, TBA tokens, web services call volume

modules.usageProbe: Active integrations; web services call volume in window.

nspb.note: Inventory of external systems touching NetSuite. Determines whether a Planning integration must coexist with others and how data flows.

modules.name: SuiteTax / Advanced Taxes
modules.usageProbe: Tax transactions / nexuses in window.

nspb.note: Compliance maturity; generally not a Planning input but matters for full ERP-health picture and multi-jurisdiction scaling.

modules.name: SuiteCommerce / Web Store
modules.usageProbe: Web order volume in window.

nspb.note: E-commerce order/traffic data can drive revenue planning if the client sells online.

modules.name: CRM / Sales Force Automation / Opportunities
modules.usageProbe: Opportunities / forecasts maintained in window.

nspb.note: Pipeline/bookings data can drive top-line revenue planning. Native sales forecasting overlaps with NSPB — decide source of truth.

modules.name: Approval Routing (SuiteApprovals)
modules.usageProbe: Transactions routed for approval in window.

nspb.note: Affects close timing and the point at which actuals are final/postable — relevant to Planning load cadence.

modules.name: Period End Journal Entries / Period Close

detect.where: Accounting tab > Period End Journal Entries; Period Close Checklist

modules.usageProbe: Are periods closed on a consistent cadence?

nspb.note: A disciplined close = clean, final actuals for Planning. Inconsistent close = unreliable actuals loads.
